segments.ja483:1.1: Āsīsetheva [āsiṃsetheva (sī. syā. pī.)] puriso, na nibbindeyya paṇḍito;
segments.ja483:1.3: Passāmi vohaṃ attānaṃ, yathā icchiṃ tathā ahu.
segments.ja483:3.3: Passāmi vohaṃ attānaṃ, yathā icchiṃ tathā ahu.
segments.ja483:5.1: Dukkhūpanītopi naro sapañño, āsaṃ na chindeyya sukhāgamāya;
segments.ja483:5.3: Bahū hi phassā ahitā hitā ca, avitakkitā maccamupabbajanti [maccumupabbajanti (ka. sī. pī.), maccumupapajjanti (syā. ka.) ettha “avitakkitāpi phasso maccaṃ janaṃ upagacchantī”ti attho].
segments.ja483:6.3: Na hi cintāmayā bhogā, itthiyā purisassa vā.
segments.ja483:7.1: Sarabhaṃ giriduggasmiṃ, yaṃ tvaṃ anusarī pure;
segments.ja483:7.3: Alīnacittassa tuvaṃ, vikkantamanujīvasi [tava, vikkantaṃ jīvitaṃ labhi (ka.)].
segments.ja483:8.1: Yo taṃ viduggā narakā samuddhari, silāya yoggaṃ sarabho karitvā;
segments.ja483:8.3: Dukkhūpanītaṃ maccumukhā pamocayi, alīnacittaṃ taṃ migaṃ [tameva (syā. ka.)] vadesi.
segments.ja483:9.1: Kiṃ tvaṃ nu [tuvannu (sī. pī.)] tattheva tadā ahosi, udāhu te koci naṃ [taṃ (ka.)] etadakkhā;
segments.ja483:9.3: Vivaṭṭacchaddo nusi sabbadassī, ñāṇaṃ nu te brāhmaṇa bhiṃsarūpaṃ.
segments.ja483:10.1: Na cevahaṃ tattha tadā ahosiṃ, na cāpi me koci naṃ [taṃ (ka.)] etadakkhā;
segments.ja483:10.3: Gāthāpadānañca subhāsitānaṃ, atthaṃ tadānenti janinda dhīrā.
segments.ja483:11.1: Ādāya pattiṃ [pattaṃ (syā.), paṭṭiṃ (ka.)] paraviriyaghātiṃ, cāpe saraṃ kiṃ vicikicchase tuvaṃ;
segments.ja483:11.3: Nunno [nuṇṇo (ka. sī. syā.), tuṇṇo (ka.)] saro sarabhaṃ hantu khippaṃ, annañhi etaṃ varapañña rañño.
segments.ja483:12.1: Addhā pajānāmi ahampi etaṃ, annaṃ migo brāhmaṇa khattiyassa;
segments.ja483:12.3: Pubbe katañca [pubbe ca kataṃ (ka.)] apacāyamāno, tasmā migaṃ sarabhaṃ no hanāmi.
segments.ja483:14.1: Sace ca rājā [rāja (sī. syā. pī.)] vicikicchase tuvaṃ, hantuṃ migaṃ sarabhaṃ sahāyakaṃ [sahāyakaṃ me (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja483:14.3: Saputtadāro naravīraseṭṭha [naraviriyaseṭṭha (sī. pī.)], gantvā [gantā (sī. pī. aṭṭha.)] tuvaṃ vetaraṇiṃ yamassa.
segments.ja483:15.1: Kāmaṃ ahaṃ jānapadā ca sabbe, puttā ca dārā ca sahāyasaṅghā;
segments.ja483:15.3: Gacchemu taṃ vetaraṇiṃ yamassa, na tveva hañño mama pāṇado yo [pāṇada’ ssa (sī. syā. pī.)].
segments.ja483:16.1: Ayaṃ migo kicchagatassa mayhaṃ, ekassa kattā vivanasmi ghore;
segments.ja483:16.3: Taṃ tādisaṃ pubbakiccaṃ saranto, jānaṃ mahābrahme kathaṃ haneyyaṃ.
segments.ja483:17.1: Mittābhirādhī cirameva jīva, rajjaṃ imaṃ dhammaguṇe [rajjampimaṃ cassa gaṇe (ka.)] pasāsa;
segments.ja483:17.3: Nārīgaṇehi paricāriyanto, modassu raṭṭhe tidiveva vāsavo.
segments.ja483:18.1: Akkodhano niccapasannacitto, sabbātithī yācayogo bhavitvā [pāhunake karitvā (syā.), yācayogo viditvā (ka.)];
segments.ja483:18.3: Datvā ca bhutvā ca yathānubhāvaṃ, anindito saggamupehi ṭhānanti.
segments.ja483:22.3: Atha bodhi akitti sutakkarinā, atha rurumigenaparo sarabhoti.
